title: Recording: You And Me (Babe), Oh My My, Devil Woman by Ringo Starr | 1973
content:
Sunset Sound Recorders, Los Angeles
Producer: Richard Perry
Engineer: Bill Schnee

Ringo Starr worked on three songs for his third studio album, Ringo, on 12 May 1973.

This was an overdub session. The backing track for ‘You And Me (Babe)’ had been recorded on 8 March, and more additions were taped on 29 June at Warner Bros Studios, and 10 July at Producers Workshop.

The second song, ‘Oh My My’, had been started on 6 March, with overdubs added on the following day and 14 March. The recording was completed on this day.

The final song, ‘Devil Woman’, had also been started on 8 March, and was completed on 11 July.
